issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain lid width to equal base width within tight tolerance measured across all views where both side edges are visible.
issues.visible_evidence: Source27 lid side edges align with base side edges; render27 lid overhangs base on both sides, right side to image border.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain lid hinge axis to coincide with base rear edge so no background gap is visible at the hinge in any open view.
issues.visible_evidence: Source27 and source44 show closed hinge line with no daylight; render27 and render44 show continuous white background slit between lid bottom and base rear.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Constrain display texture selection per-view state or use neutral dark material when source screen is powered off.
issues.visible_evidence: Source27 screen is uniform powered-off black; render27 shows bright NITRO boot graphic not present in that source state.

issues.suggested_geometric_constraint: Do not penalize edge clipping in optimization when source frame itself clips the held part.
issues.visible_evidence: Source27 right hand/lid is already at image border; render27 clipping partly reproduces source framing, exaggerated by wider lid.

limitations: Seam UV endpoints are approximate visual hints, not metric truth.
Cannot certify true contact, scale, or thickness from monocular RGB; only visible relative mating.
Hands, table and wall in source have no render counterpart; blank background expected.
Display on/off state changes over time; single static texture cannot match both states.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep lid width equal to base width; penalize lid side-edge overhang beyond base side edges in any view.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Exact millimeter width and bevel thickness not observable.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep hinge edge at base rear edge; penalize any visible background slit between lid bottom and base rear in open views.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: Internal hinge mechanism and exact axis depth not observable.

proposed_rules.rule: Keep opening angle consistent with source silhouette and forbid lid volume intersecting keyboard volume; allow small non-penetrating contact tolerance.
proposed_rules.unobservable_or_unknown: True contact pressure and closed slab thickness not certifiable.

proposed_rules.rule: Preserve correct panel facing: display inward to keyboard, underside with vents outward when closed, exterior outward.

sample_reviews.evidence: Closed slab shows underside vents facing camera, thin lid behind; width and stacking plausible, no sinking visible in this view.
Lid is correct rear-hinged edge but too wide vs base and leaves white rear gap; dark off-screen rendered with boot logo; right overflow partly exists in source framing.
Frontal open view hinge on correct rear edge, no lid-keyboard penetration; residual white hinge slit and display logo blur differ from sharp source boot graphic.

summary: Lid is on correct rear edge with correct facing; closed view plausible. Oversized-width complaint confirmed in 27 where lid overhangs base, right overflow exaggerated but source also clips. Sinking-into-keyboard not observed; opposite residual rear gap with daylight slit in 27 and 44. Display texture mismatch in 27 only; 44 boot graphic plausibly reproduced.
